description: MassArt professor Nicholas Nixon's intimate black-and-white portraits trace his subjects' physical changes over time, and explore his own family dynamic. name: ALS Association's Scotch and Chocolate Event
description: On Thursday, February 10, The ALS Association Massachusetts Chapter will host its first Inaugural Scotch and Chocolate event at The Commandant's House in Charlestown. This night of decadence will feature Sir Jeremy Bell, Glenlivet Brand Ambassador, presenting expert pairings of scotch, champagne and port with fruit and chocolate. Bell will dazzle guests with a sabering lesson. The event will also include a professional cigar roller from Cigar Masters, live and silent auctions. Among other surprises in our auctions are a Josh Beckett signed shirt, a one-week Cape house rental in July, spa packages and a scotch and cigar tasting for four at Cigar Masters.

description: Legendary glassblower Dale Chihuly and his wife Leslie will attend a reception at the Fairmont Battery Wharf Hotel to both support the Melanoma Foundation of New England, and to celebrate the upcoming unveiling of his newest exhibit at the Museum of Fine Arts, Chihuly: Through the Looking Glass. name: 2nd Annual Sustainable Seaside Wedding Show
description: The Trustees of Reservations is hosting their second annual Sustainable Seaside Wedding Show on April 10. The event will offer a positive wealth of eco-friendly wedding advice with over 60 vendors on hand to lend their expertise to couples and planners in wedding preparation mode. Food, flower and stationary samples will also be available – all locally sourced and sustainably crafted. The show returns by popular demand; over 300 people attended the first event, and organizers hope to create a gala equally, if not more, successful this year.

name: Friends of Boston's Homeless Beyond Shelter Gala
description: On April 28th,  Friends of Boston’s Homeless will hold the 24th annual Beyond Shelter Gala at House of Blues. The event, hosted by Mayor Menino and led by the organization's founder, John Rosenthal, will include live music, a raffle and auction — including Red Sox-autographed sports memorabilia and luxury weekend getaways — plus gourmet tastings from some of the city's top chefs. Participating restaurants include Hamersley's Bistro, Eastern Standard and Treat Cupcake Bar. All proceeds will go to benefit Friends of Boston's Homeless and its mission to aid the city's most vulnerable population.

name: Jack Sidell's Circle of Legendary Boston Food Friends
description: This month, the first annual Jack Sidell's Circle of Legendary Boston  Food Friends will take place in honor of the late, great Jack Sidell.  The event, held at Davio's, will be  emceed by Annie Copps and co-hosted  by Sidell's two daughters,  Stephanie and Kathy. Top chefs from around  town, including Jasper White and Dante de Magistris, will prepare  samples of their favorite dishes, to be shared along with their own  stories and anecdotes of the honoree. Proceeds from the event will go to  Massachusetts General Hospital, for the extraordinary care it provided  during Sidell's illness.
